entities.name: PMID:27493882
observations: 2016 report: a large Brazilian family with familial papillary thyroid carcinoma; screened SDHA, SDHB, SDHC, and SDHD by PCR-SSCP and direct sequencing.

entities.name: No SDH defect association
observations: A rare SDHA variant did not segregate with disease, and no other tested SDHx variants were found in affected relatives; authors concluded familial PTC/GIST was not associated with SDHx mutations. SDHAF2 was not listed as tested.
